objective: Evaluate a secure, reversible Obot MCP gateway deployment on the Factory Podman control plane and make an evidence-backed go/no-go decision before production integration.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the pinned supported Obot image and configured control-plane topology, when an operator runs the documented local deploy and validation flow, then an isolated container exposes a healthy MCP endpoint without changing model-gateway configuration.

Given a clean isolated sandbox with the intended agent transport, when it authenticates, then it can discover and invoke one authorized read-only GitHub MCP tool; failed authentication and broker outage provide actionable diagnostics.
Given the POC deployment, when backup, restore, upgrade, rollback, and teardown are followed, then persistent data is recoverable and all resources can be removed without touching unrelated services.
Given the OAuth/MCP scopes and tool exposure, when the security review is completed, then allowed and denied capabilities and redacted logging behavior are documented with evidence.

Given measured resource use and demonstrated behavior against the listed alternatives, when the evaluation report is reviewed, then it records the go/no-go decision and explicitly prevents production rollout before that decision.
nonGoals: Migrate the model gateway or change LiteLLM/vLLM deployment.
Enable write-capable GitHub tools or broad project access.
Roll out Obot to production agent workflows before a documented go decision.
Add compute-running GitHub Actions; deployment, validation, and teardown remain operator-run local flows.
risks: The gateway handles agent credentials and exposes remote tools, so scope leakage or unintended executable tools have meaningful security impact. Keep GitHub read-only, isolate the sandbox, store credentials only in host-local secret facilities, redact logs, test failure cases, and require a documented go/no-go before integration. Pin the image version and provide rollback/teardown.
dependencies: No blocking issue dependency is specified. Use the existing control-plane inventory in config/server-topology.env and follow integrations/deployment/README.md and integrations/bazzite/README.md. Related context: #60 and #128.
suggestedWorkBreakdown: Inspect and pin an Obot release and license; define the isolated compose/service and host-local secret inputs; implement local deploy, validation, backup/restore, rollback, and teardown instructions; test read-only GitHub access and failure diagnostics in a clean sandbox; review OAuth scopes, logging, and exposed tools; measure resource footprint and compare alternatives; publish evidence and go/no-go recommendation.
